description: Logical projects agent-fabric manages. A working copy is matched to a project by its origin remote (or a .agent-fabric-project marker at its toplevel), never by its directory name. `taxonomy` and `memory` are paths INSIDE the project's working copy (its .agent-fabric/); other paths here are repository-relative; machine-specific checkout locations live in each agent's runtime binding. `memory` is where the project's distilled knowledge lives INSIDE the project's working copy (fabric-coordinator's to write; every role reads it). `license` is the SPDX identifier the project's OWN tree carries — information about the project, not about anything here: this repository is Apache-2.0 throughout, projects/<id>/ included.

agent_env.OPENAI_API_KEY: OpenAI API key for scripts that call it directly (gzapp.decks image generation). One per login: a service account agent-fabric-<login> in the organisation's project (enroll.sh issue-openai-keys, with the coordinator's admin key), so the Usage API reports spend per agent
agent_env.OPENROUTER_API_KEY: OpenRouter API key for the broker launch path (runtime/openrouter/launch). One per login, named after it (enroll.sh issue-openrouter-keys, with the coordinator's provisioning key), so the dashboard reports spend per agent; never inherited from another login's config

agent_env.GZAPP_PORT_OFFSET: the port offset of this login's local stack (infra/local/port-offsets.tsv); exported by fabric-secrets sync, wins over .env.local and the table

kutaisi-shop-transit.title: Kutaisi shop-to-transit matching (OSM shops against bus/marshrutka lines)
kutaisi-shop-transit.note: A private repository whose tree carries no license file: all rights reserved by default. One role, domain-transit; its working copy is that account's (moved there 2026-09-15).

gzapi.ge.title: gzapi.ge — the company website (Gzapi LLC)
gzapi.ge.note: Static Astro site, vision-level by rule, ka/en. The brand's source of truth: where a deck and the site disagree on a token or a phrase, the site wins (owner, 2026-09-15). One role, brand-comms. A private repository whose tree carries no license file: all rights reserved by default. Moved to gzapi-org on 2026-09-16; the andreabenetton spellings stay listed for clones not yet re-pointed.

gzapi.brand.title: gzapi.brand — the brand's source of authority
gzapi.brand.note: Names, claims by audience, the brand subset of the design tokens, the asset register and the decision records; no code, no build. The brand's source of authority since the owner's decision of 2026-09-17 (brand/decisions/0001), superseding the 2026-09-15 ruling that gzapi.ge was: the site, the decks and the product's shared web tokens copy the brand subset at a pinned commit and record it. One role, brand-comms; the owner decides, brand-comms proposes. A private repository whose tree carries no licence file; registered by fabric-coordinator on 2026-09-17.

gzapp.decks.title: gzapp.decks — brand presentation decks (Marp)
gzapp.decks.note: Marp decks under one brand theme whose tokens are vendored from gzapi.ge (the source of truth); bilingual, an asset register every image has a row in, PDFs as versioned build output. One role, brand-comms. A private repository whose tree carries no license file: all rights reserved by default; the vendored fonts are OFL-1.1. Moved to gzapi-org on 2026-09-16; the andreabenetton spellings stay listed for clones not yet re-pointed.
